title: Read every shop in order
prompt: `Source` is supplied. Write `public static async Task<List<int>> CountsAsync(List<string> shops)`. Read each shop in order and return the counts in the same order. When a shop is offline, put -1 in its place and carry on with the next shop.
hints: If the second of three shops fails, how many numbers must the result have?
Each read needs its own try and catch, so one failure does not end the loop.
Inside the loop, await the count in a try and add it. In the catch for InvalidOperationException, add -1.
checkLabels: north then south must give 3 then 5 after one read of each shop in input order.
An offline shop in the middle must give -1 there, and each shop must be read once in input order.
No shops must give an empty list and make no calls.
A single offline shop must give -1 after one call.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Wraps the whole loop in one try, so the first failure ends the reading.
Leaves a failed shop out instead of marking it with -1.
Reads shops in reverse order, then reverses the result to hide it.

feedback: Count the numbers in your result for three shops where the middle one is offline. There must be three, with -1 in the middle.
